Washed medium-blue cotton twill midi skirt with gentle pleats at the waist, falling mid-calf to skim over boots, offering easy movement for a walk.
Tailored cream merino wool cardigan with dropped shoulders and long sleeves, knitted in an open rib texture that complements the split-toned hair.
Classic black leather Chelsea ankle boots with a low block heel, smooth finish suitable for autumn daylight and pavement.
Delicate gold hoop earrings in polished brass, adding a subtle touch of elegance without overwhelming the casual yet cozy ensemble.
This outfit works perfectly for an autumn day walk because the chunky knit scarf acts as both a stylish focal point and practical warmth, drawing attention to the face while respecting the wearer's wish for coverage under the chin. The neutral palette of camel, cream, and black harmonizes beautifully with her unique two-toned hair, ensuring the split shades of copper and light blonde remain visible rather than being overwhelmed by clashing colors.
